dialogues.speaker: Dulphy
dialogues.text: I mean, of course I have some regrets, but...

dialogues.speaker: Lauwick
dialogues.text: There'll be plenty of opportunities in the future for us to tell the stories that we want on stage.

dialogues.speaker: Pauleau
dialogues.text: I'm just finishing packing up. As soon as I'm done, I've got an interview with the Steambird to get to.

dialogues.speaker: Pauleau
dialogues.text: Thanks to all your help, the show was more perfect than we ever could have hoped for.

dialogues.speaker: Pauleau
dialogues.text: But most of all... I want to thank you for giving me the chance to finally say farewell to Aurelie.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: It's ironic to think that in my whole time as a "god," I could only ever dream of receiving this kind of power...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: And now that the gods have given me their blessing... It actually feels more like I'm finally able to take my fate in my own hands.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Is... is that how humans feel about it as well?

dialogues.speaker: Buraud
dialogues.text: Now that the buzz has worn off, I feel ready to pass out.

dialogues.speaker: Elain
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. I feel like I've rekindled the passion I had when I first joined the troupe.

dialogues.speaker: Elain
dialogues.text: It might turn out to be too little, too late for me... But still, this has been the experience of a lifetime.
